text:
asha: quick sync: we need a tiny 'cost heartbeat' card for rollout ribbons. shows tokens/min, cache-saved tokens/min, model variant delta. refresh 60s. ok?
ben: yes. big ops question: sampling strategy. full capture is too heavy.
sylvia: propose two-tier sampling: default 0.5% reservoir, but deterministic-force 100% for flagged canaries for first N min. also send sampling_weight.
asha: how should telemetry be emitted? add fields to spans or emit dedicated econ events?
ben: spans easier to integrate with traces, but retention and schemas get messy. dedicated econ events give control.
sylvia: hybrid: enrich spans at router with minimal econ fields and have a materializer that emits condensed econ events into a short-lived index. Console reads index.
metrics-bot: ESTIMATE: short-lived index at 0.5% sampling ~ +2GB/day. Can be trimmed by 1h retention.
asha: schema suggestion: econ.heartbeat.v1 -> [model_variant, sampled_tokens, sampling_weight, cache_delta_tokens, route_alias, canary_flag, tenant_hash, ts]. keep names short.
ben: example payload (for devs): {schema:econ.heartbeat.v1,model_variant:luminous-7b,q_tag:q4_0,sampled_tokens:87,sampling_weight:200,cache_delta_tokens:21,route_alias:sum-v2,canary_flag:true,tenant_hash:h_xxx,ts:6371111111}
sylvia: UI: show absolute and per-request normalized numbers, small confidence glyph when sample_count < 30. expand to 1h chart on click.
asha: dev tasks: ben -> router span enrichment + sampler, sylvia -> materializer job + index writer, ash a -> Console card mock. Check-in Tue.
ben: add config flag to ramp sampling per-cluster. ops will monitor write QPS.
metrics-bot: ALERT: enable auto-throttle if index write errors >3% for 5m.
sylvia: note: low-volume tenants need deterministic sampling or they'll be invisible; we'll force-sample first 50 reqs/hr for canaries.
asha: good. I'll draft a one-pager and attach schema PR. Thanks.
